title: Release legs stop saving tag-scoped target caches; record the v0.21.27 leg timings
goal: Measured on the v0.21.27 release run (2026-10-31): sccache hit 0 of 892 compiles on the Windows leg, whose cold dist build took 23.6 of its 28 minutes; a GitHub Actions cache written on a tag ref is readable only by that tag, and the ~1 GB target cache each leg saved was never read again while evicting Test's shard caches (9 of the 10 GB quota). release.yml's build and build-cuda legs set cache-targets false and the header says why; docs/workflow-speed.md gains the measured release-leg table, the macOS cancellation that left v0.21.27 unpublished, and the remaining levers.
